description: Retrieve a single receipt by its ID from local SQLite storage. Returns the full receipt object including all 27 fields: identity, timestamps, action data, performance metrics, constraints, cryptographic proof, and metadata. Returns an error message if the receipt ID does not exist. Use to inspect a specific receipt or retrieve it before verification.

receipt_id.description: The receipt ID to retrieve (format: "rcpt_" followed by 12 alphanumeric characters)

name: get_receipt
